whatsappMessage:
Hi Team A V FOOD PLAZA,

I noticed your food plaza near WALMI on AIIMS Road in Patna has a solid local presence, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online orders and table bookings.

Maine aapke food plaza ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, aur location/directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/avfoodplaza

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (A V FOOD PLAZA) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, aur AIIMS Road location details ke sath. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, prices aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
